```{r setup, include=FALSE}
Sys.setenv(VELKSCALA_ROOT = "E:/Active Projects/Project 1746 - Intellte/papers/velkscala")

# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}
```

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
fmt_eu_pop <- function (val) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(val)
  if (v <= 0) return("-")
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    m <- round(v / 1000000, 2)
    s <- gsub("\\.", ",", format(m, nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE))
    s <- sub(",00$", "", s)
    s <- sub("^(,[0-9])0$", "\\1", s)
    s <- sub("(,[1-9])0$", "\\1", s)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    k <- round(v / 1000, 1)
    if (k == floor(k)) {
      return(paste0(formatC(as.integer(k), format = "d", big.mark = "."), "k"))
    }
    return(paste0(gsub("\\.", ",", format(k, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE)), "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(as.integer(round(v))))
}

fmt_eu_coord <- function (x) {
  s <- format(round(as.numeric(x), 2), nsmall = 2, trim = TRUE)
  gsub("\\.", ",", s)
}

get_entry_pop <- function (entry, yr_str) {
  p <- entry$population[[yr_str]]
  if (is.null(p)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(p)
}

clean_reg_short <- function (nm) {
  s <- sub("\\s*\\(.*$", "", as.character(nm))
  s <- gsub("Governorates", "Gubs.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Governorate", "Gub.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Province of the ", "", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Governor-Generalship", "Gov.-Gen.", s, fixed = TRUE)
  trimws(s)
}

hyphenate_post1815_words <- function (s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  s <- gsub("Blagoveshchensk", "Blagovesh-chensk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Verkhneudinsk", "Verkhne-udinsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Petropavlovskaya", "Petropavlov-skaya", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Petropavlovsk", "Petropav-lovsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Novonikolaevsk", "Novonikola-evsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Troitskosavsk", "Troitsko-savsk", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s <- gsub("Aleksandrovsky", "Aleksandrov-sky", s, fixed = TRUE)
  s
}

build_region_df <- function (reg_slug) {
  sub_list <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(reg48_map[[e$key]]), as.character(reg_slug)), all_entries)
  rows <- lapply(sub_list, function (e) {
    raw_oth <- if (length(e$other_names) > 0) unlist(e$other_names) else character(0)
    if (length(raw_oth) > 1) {
      oth <- paste(head(raw_oth, 2L), collapse = "; ")
    } else if (length(raw_oth) == 1) {
      oth <- raw_oth[1]
    } else {
      oth <- "-"
    }
    coords_span <- paste0(
      fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[1]]), ", ", fmt_eu_coord(e$coords[[2]]),
      " (", e$country, ")"
    )
    data.frame(
      `Settlement` = hyphenate_post1815_words(e$name),
      `Historical / Local Names` = hyphenate_post1815_words(oth),
      `Coords & Country` = coords_span,
      `1815AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1815")),
      `1858AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1858")),
      `1897AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1897")),
      `1914AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1914")),
      `1917AD` = fmt_eu_pop(get_entry_pop(e, "1917")),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

# Abstract

This gazetteer compiles population estimates for 265 cities, industrial towns, railway junctions and ports across the 48 provinces of Late Imperial Russia and Austro-Hungarian Ukraine at five benchmark dates between the Congress of Vienna in 1815AD and the Russian Revolution of 1917AD. Before the emancipation of the serfs in the 1860s, urban growth remained modest outside Saint Petersburg, Moscow, Warsaw, Odessa and Riga. Over the next half-century, railway building, coal and steel works in the Donbas and Congress Poland, the Grozny and Boryslav oil booms and peasant migration along the Trans-Siberian line transformed the urban map. By 1914AD, Saint Petersburg (2,12M) and Moscow (1,76M) led an urban network that included Warsaw (884,5k), Odessa (630k), Kyiv (626,3k), Riga (517,5k) and the textile and mining boomtowns of Lodz (477,9k), Sosnowiec (118,5k) and Yuzovka (54k), before the First World War emptied frontline cities in Poland, Courland and Lithuania and swelled interior towns with more than 6M refugees [@Troinitsky1905Goroda; @TsSK1915; @Rashin1956; @Gatrell1999].

# Methodology

This gazetteer traces the population histories of 265 towns, industrial centres, ports and fortresses across the 48 provinces of Late Imperial Russia and Austro-Hungarian Ukraine (excluding Central Asia and the Southern Caucasus) from the Congress of Vienna in 1815AD to the revolutions of 1917AD. Each town is listed under its historical name alongside its local and modern equivalents, geographic coordinates and population estimates for 1815AD, 1858AD, 1897AD, 1914AD and 1917AD.

The town figures draw on the main fiscal and statistical surveys of the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries: the Seventh (1815-1816AD), Eighth (1833-1835AD) and Tenth (1857-1858AD) Imperial Soul Revisions and Ministry of Internal Affairs town tables [@Troinitsky1861; @Kabuzan1971; @Rashin1956], the First All-Russian General Census of 28 January 1897AD across all 89 provincial volumes and its companion register of settlements over 500 inhabitants [@Troinitsky1905; @Troinitsky1905Goroda], the 1 January 1914AD yearbooks of the Central Statistical Committee and the Warsaw Statistical Committee [@TsSK1915; @WarsawStat1914], the ten-year censuses of the Finnish Statistical Office [@FinlandStat1870_1915], the Austrian and Hungarian censuses of 1869-1910AD for Galicia, Bukovina and Subcarpathia [@OsterreichischeStatistik1912; @MagyarStatisztika1912] and the 1916-1917AD All-Russian Urban and Agricultural Censuses paired with Tatiana Committee wartime refugee records [@AgCensus1917; @Gatrell1999]. Industrial, coal-mining, railway and northern ports founded after 1815AD - such as Bodaibo (1864AD), Yuzovka (1869AD), Novonikolaevsk (1893AD), Belotsarsk (1914AD) and Romanov-on-Murman (1916AD) - are marked `-` at dates prior to their establishment.

```{r fig1-md-only, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}

      caption = "The 48 provinces and 265 catalogued cities, industrial centres, railway junctions and ports across Late Imperial Russia and Austro-Hungarian Ukraine from 1815AD to 1917AD.",
```

# Results

## Warsaw, Plock and Lomza Governorates

Table \ref{tab:reg1-sites} gives the populations of the 6 principal towns in the Warsaw, Plock and Lomza governorates, where the regional population grew from 1,02M in 1815AD to 3,54M in 1897AD and 5,05M in 1914AD before falling to 4,42M in 1917AD during the First World War [@WarsawStat1914; @Troinitsky1905Goroda; @Corrsin1989; @Gatrell1999].

```{r table-reg1, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
df_reg1 <- build_region_df("poland_warsaw_plock_lomza")
render_table_template(
  df_reg1,
  list(
    caption = "Populations of Warsaw, the linen-mill town of Zyrardow, the Vistula river ports of Wloclawek and Plock and the northern Mazovian district seats, 1815AD - 1917AD.",
    label = "tab:reg1-sites"
  )
)
```

# Appendix

## Regional Urban Population Summary

Table \ref{tab:regional-summary} sums the populations of all 265 towns across the 48 provinces from 1815AD to 1917AD [@Troinitsky1905Goroda; @TsSK1915; @Rashin1956; @AgCensus1917].

```{r table-regional-summary, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
bench_yrs <- c("1815", "1858", "1897", "1914", "1917")
sum_rows <- lapply(seq_along(summary_meta$regions), function (idx) {
  reg <- summary_meta$regions[[idx]]
  rslug <- as.character(reg$id)
  sub_e <- Filter(function (e) identical(as.character(reg48_map[[e$key]]), rslug), all_entries)
  raw_sums <- sapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
    vals <- sapply(sub_e, function (e) {
      v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
      if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
    })
    sum(vals)
  })
  sums <- sapply(raw_sums, fmt_eu_pop)
  if (raw_sums[["1815"]] <= 0) {
    pct_s <- "Post-1850AD"
  } else {
    pct <- round((raw_sums[["1914"]] - raw_sums[["1815"]]) / raw_sums[["1815"]] * 100, 1)
    pct_s <- paste0(if (pct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")
  }
  data.frame(
    `Region (Towns)` = paste0(clean_reg_short(reg$name), " (", length(sub_e), ")"),
    `1815AD` = sums[["1815"]],
    `1858AD` = sums[["1858"]],
    `1897AD` = sums[["1897"]],
    `1914AD` = sums[["1914"]],
    `1917AD` = sums[["1917"]],
    `1815-1914AD` = pct_s,
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
df_sum <- do.call(rbind, sum_rows)

tot_raw <- sapply(bench_yrs, function (y) {
  vals <- sapply(all_entries, function (e) {
    v <- get_entry_pop(e, y)
    if (is.na(v)) 0 else v
  })
  sum(vals)
})
tot_sums <- sapply(tot_raw, fmt_eu_pop)
tot_pct <- round((tot_raw[["1914"]] - tot_raw[["1815"]]) / tot_raw[["1815"]] * 100, 1)
tot_pct_s <- paste0(if (tot_pct > 0) "+" else "", sub(",0$", "", gsub("\\.", ",", format(tot_pct, nsmall = 1, trim = TRUE))), "%")

tot_row <- data.frame(
  `Region (Towns)` = paste0("All 48 Regions (", length(all_entries), " towns)"),
  `1815AD` = tot_sums[["1815"]],
  `1858AD` = tot_sums[["1858"]],
  `1897AD` = tot_sums[["1897"]],
  `1914AD` = tot_sums[["1914"]],
  `1917AD` = tot_sums[["1917"]],
  `1815-1914AD` = tot_pct_s,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
df_sum <- rbind(df_sum, tot_row)

render_table_template(
  df_sum,
  list(
    caption = "Combined urban population of all 265 catalogued towns across each of the 48 provinces at five benchmark dates from 1815AD to 1917AD, with percentage growth from 1815AD to 1914AD.",
    label = "tab:regional-summary"
  )
)
```
